doc_title_en: Notice Regarding Change in Dividend Policy (Setting Target Payout Ratio and Introduction of DOE Metric, Implementation of Semi-annual Dividend) and Revision of Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
doc_title_jp: 配当方針の変更（配当性向の目標の設定とDOE指標の新設、中間配当の導入）及び配当予想の修正（増配）に関するお知らせ

key_facts.reason_jp: 成長投資と株主還元の充実、資本効率向上を同時に追求し、予見可能性を高めるため

summary_en: Payout ratio target raised to 50% (medium-to-long term). DOE (dividend payout ratio on equity) floor set at 5%. Semi-annual dividend structure introduced (interim + final). Dividend forecast revised upward for FY3/27.
summary_jp: 配当性向目標を50%に設定。DOE下限を5%に設定。中間配当と期末配当の年2回に変更。FY3/27配当予想を増配に修正。
tag_en: Dividend Policy Change – Payout Ratio Target 50%, DOE Floor 5%, Semi-annual Dividend Introduced
tag_jp: 配当方針変更 – 配当性向目標50%、DOE下限5%、中間配当導入
